## User need

Describe the task and the information currently missing. Avoid private recordings
or real sensitive workspaces; use a synthetic example.

## Proposed behavior

Describe what the user should see or be able to do. For a new observer, identify
the supported evidence source and distinguish direct observations from inference.

## Scope and limits

Explain what data would be collected, how the user would select its scope, and
what should remain unknown or unavailable. Consider redaction, resource bounds,
background helper windows, and stopping without interrupting attached work.

## Validation

Describe a small synthetic demonstration or test that would establish the new
behavior. Mention alternatives or workarounds if relevant.
